The Wangari Preamble Gift Set Hamper is a thoughtfully curated sustainable gifting solution designed for modern businesses that value innovation, elegance, and environmental responsibility. Crafted to make a lasting impression, this premium Product Type:- Gift set comes in an elegant Packaging Type:- Box and reflects the commitment to sustainability and design excellence that defines the Brand:- Wangari.

Ideal for corporate gifting, festive occasions, employee appreciation, and premium client giveaways, the combines eco-conscious materials with cutting-edge utility products. Each item in the is selected to enhance everyday workspaces while promoting responsible consumption.

What’s Inside

  • Wangari Pine 15W Square Bamboo Wireless Charger with USB Hub
    A fast and efficient wireless charging solution made from natural bamboo. This 15W charger supports multiple devices simultaneously, making it ideal for office desks and home workspaces. The integrated USB hub ensures seamless connectivity while maintaining a clean and organized setup.
  • Wangari Custom 3D Printed Desk Lamp
    Designed using advanced 3D printing technology, this modern desk lamp is made from Key materials: Polylactic Acid (PLA), a biodegradable and eco-friendly material derived from renewable resources. The lamp delivers warm ambient lighting while reinforcing sustainable design values.
  • Soul & Scents Mahogany Reed Diffuser
    Infused with rich mahogany notes, this premium reed diffuser creates a calming and sophisticated environment. Perfect for offices and living spaces, it enhances mood and productivity while adding a luxurious sensory experience.
  • Iris Red Pillar Candles (Set of 2)
    Elegant and long-lasting, these red pillar candles bring warmth and aesthetic charm to any space. Ideal for festive décor, relaxation, or mindful moments.
  • Eco Friendly Diary with Recycled Fabric & Handmade Paper
    This sustainable diary is made from recycled fabric and handmade paper. It is 100% Tree Free and Acid Free, ensuring durability while reducing environmental impact. A perfect companion for notes, planning, and creative writing.
  • Nibs – Hazelnut Milk Chocolate Bar
    A delightful gourmet addition, this premium hazelnut milk chocolate bar offers a smooth and indulgent taste, making the gift set even more memorable.
